manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the blue pen on the box and insert it into the pen holder on the right.

Task description: The object is the blue pen on the box, with other pens nearby. Insert it through the opening of the pen holder on the right side of the scene.

Success criteria: The blue pen has been inserted through the right-side pen holder opening and remains inside. Hovering above the opening or resting across the rim does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- The blue pen crosses a neighboring pen. Choose an exposed barrel section away from the crossing with clearance on both sides, placing pads on the straight barrel and avoiding clips or detachable caps to prevent lifting the other pen or an insecure grasp.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the pen barrel and close across it. Before closing, confirm the pads are actually on opposite sides of the barrel rather than treating image overlap as an effective enclosure.
- Grasp nearer the end intended to remain outside the holder, leaving length for insertion. Adjust pen orientation in free space above the box and nearby pen to reduce long-pen sweeping collisions or gripper contact with the holder rim.
- Point the pen end downward and align it with an unobstructed gap inside the holder opening. If the tip or rim is obscured, adjust the viewing angle and confirm their relative positions before approaching, avoiding direct downward pressure.
- If the pen contacts the holder rim, retreat slightly and correct rather than forcing it and causing the pen to bridge the opening or tip the holder. Confirm it has entered and gained support before release to reduce falling outside.

narration: I will use the piper-control skill to read the generated manual and live observations, run only this authorized real-robot episode, and call finish_episode when finished or unable to continue.

The blue pen is confirmed on the box surface, crossing another pen, and the holder is visible on the right. The head-camera image is dim. I will rely mainly on the wrist camera and measured pose, first adjusting the grasp pose above the objects.

A pose adjustment triggered a joint-limit event once. I backed off based on the returned measured position and normal movement resumed. Next I will continue approaching the blue pen from above the box, avoiding the crossing point.

I am above the blue pen and can distinguish its blue grip section and the intersection with the barrel. I am adjusting the finger orientation to enclose the barrel sideways; I will close only after confirming the pads are on opposite sides.

The grasp direction has been adjusted to nearly horizontal. Next I will align with the exposed pen shaft using small lateral movements, then descend gradually while checking clearance to avoid the neighboring pen.

The projected pen shaft is aligned between the two fingers, but the gripper has not closed. I am descending by centimeters, continuing to check the actual contact height and clearance from nearby pens.

The gripper has narrowed to about 14 mm. The exposed pen shaft remains between the fingers, and the neighboring pen has not visibly moved. Next I will grip lightly and lift slightly to check whether it is actually held.

The small lift just attempted did not confirm that the pen rose off the box surface with the gripper; the grasp appears not to have been established. I reopened the gripper and will lower the grasp height further at the same position before checking again.

The pen rotated slightly during contact, and a reliable grasp was not established. I will adjust lateral alignment to its new shaft position and try to grasp it again; I will not carry it to the holder yet.

During this lift, the blue pen remained stable relative to the gripper, whose measured opening stayed approximately 14.4 mm, supporting that it is grasped. Next I will raise it clear of the box surface, move toward the holder on the right, and adjust the insertion orientation.
The blue pen remained stable during transport and rotation, and the right-side pen holder opening is now in the wrist view. I am bringing the pen close to vertical and aligning above the opening.

Rotation toward vertical triggered a wrist singularity limit; I returned to a reachable pose, and the blue pen remains securely held. I will adjust the wrist orientation and continue aligning based on the holder opening.

The blue pen is now near the area above the holder and remains securely grasped. The gripper obscures its lower end in the wrist view. I will combine the head image with small position and height adjustments and confirm entry into the opening before release.

The head view is now clear: the pen's lower end aligns with the left gap in the holder, while the other pen is on the right. I will continue descending in small steps and watch whether the end enters and the holder stays stable.

The pen's lower end has entered the holder opening's visible region; neither the holder nor adjacent pen moved noticeably. I will descend slightly more, confirm the end is inside the rim, release and observe whether it stays inside.

After release, the blue pen fell onto the table outside the pen holder, so the task is incomplete. There are 30 turns left. I will assess whether its new position permits regrasping within this episode, avoiding blindly continuing insertion.

While approaching the pen on the table again, the target was rejected by the tool's lateral workspace boundary (TCP y minimum: −30 cm). I will adjust the observation position within the permitted range and check for a reachable grasp near the end closest to the robot.

I found an approach direction near the end closest to the robot within the allowed range. I am now checking whether the pen tail can be regrasped. If a reliable grasp cannot be established, or too few turns remain for placement, I will end this episode.
Live images show the on-site operator's hands near the gripper and touching the blue pen. I will send no more motion commands and immediately end this episode. Current observations do not meet the requirement that the blue pen remain in the pen holder.
